description: Classifies the specific order status phase or issue type described in the customer message to trigger the correct fulfillment or logistics workflow.

problems.prompt:
Read the customer message and identify the order status category that is either explicitly stated or directly implied. Select exactly one.

Categories:
- pending: Order not yet processed; customer asking before shipment.
- shipped: Order has left warehouse; customer wants tracking or confirms dispatch.
- in_transit: Carrier has package; customer asks about intermediate location or estimated arrival.
- out_for_delivery: Package is with local courier; customer asks about today's delivery.
- delivered: Customer confirms receipt, reports missing package after delivery scan, or asks about proof of delivery.
- delayed: Explicit mention of late shipment, missed estimated date, or carrier delay.
- cancelled: Order voided by customer or system; questions about cancellation confirmation or refund timing.
- returned: Return initiated, reverse logistics, or refund after return.
- unknown: No order status information is present or inferable.

Message: {message}

Output only the exact status label.

args: Hi, I just placed order #12345 and realized I put the wrong address. Can you update it before it ships?
My order was dispatched yesterday but I never received a tracking link. Can you send me the tracking number?
The tracking shows my package left Chicago two days ago but hasn't updated since. Where is it now?
It says out for delivery since 8am. Will it arrive before 5pm today?
Thanks, I got the package this morning. Everything looks great!
My package was supposed to arrive last Friday but it's still not here. Why is it late?
I cancelled my order yesterday. When will the refund hit my credit card?
I dropped the return package at the post office yesterday. Have you received it back yet?
Do you offer gift wrapping for birthday presents?
The tracking says delivered but I never found the box on my porch. Can you provide proof of delivery?
